title: GPT Image 2 Prompt Gallery & Skill
summary: A curated collection of 160+ high-signal prompts and an agentic skill for OpenAI's GPT Image 2 model. It uses a Reference Gallery Atlas architecture to optimize context window efficiency for AI assistants and autonomous agents.
research_notes: Includes a unique budget dial feature to control API spending and specialized prompts for research figures, UI mockups, and complex scene editing.

evolution.summary: Pivoted from a flat prompt list to a structured Atlas architecture with category-specific files to minimize token usage for agents. Added a dedicated CLI tool installable via uv and official plugin support for Claude Code and Codex.
